metadata.title: Pricey AI Stocks Face an Earnings Test After Valuations Slide<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
It’s a High-Stakes Earnings Season, Especially for AI Stocks
The market’s most expensive stocks—including some AI favorites—have experienced unusually sharp valuation declines, raising the stakes for earnings season.
